description: This file defines a Java interface 'DeleteAttributeLiveCommandAnswerBuilder' for building responses and events related to the 'DeleteAttribute' command within a live signals command framework. It includes nested interfaces 'ResponseFactory' and 'EventFactory' for constructing command responses and event notifications, respectively.

classes.name: DeleteAttributeLiveCommandAnswerBuilder
classes.description: Interface for building command responses and events for DeleteAttribute commands.

classes.name: DeleteAttributeLiveCommandAnswerBuilder.ResponseFactory
classes.description: Factory interface for creating command response objects related to DeleteAttribute.

classes.name: DeleteAttributeLiveCommandAnswerBuilder.EventFactory
classes.description: Factory interface for creating event objects (AttributeDeleted) related to DeleteAttribute commands.

methods.name: deleted
methods.description: Builds a DeleteAttributeResponse or AttributeDeleted event based on command values.

methods.name: attributeNotAccessibleError
methods.description: Creates a ThingErrorResponse indicating the attribute was not accessible.

methods.name: attributeNotModifiableError
methods.description: Creates a ThingErrorResponse indicating the attribute was not modifiable.
